articles.title: Agnes Sokolov, 87, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Agnes Sokolov for the many years of service to Upper Commons.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Bellwood Chapel in his or her name.

Born in Upper Commons in the years after the war, Agnes Sokolov spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Agnes Sokolov died in November at home on Carver Place, at the age of 87.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Upper Commons. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Bellwood Chapel in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: The Accessible Ramp on Foundry Street Needs Attention
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting. Please keep the accessible ramp in the budget. Many of us on Foundry Street use it every week.

To the editor: I have lived on Foundry Street for 34 years, and I want to say what a difference the Marsh Landing Pond Committee has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Nadia Orchard, Foundry Row
